style: Bright, soft 3D cartoon animation for children, warm autumn colours, simple clean background, gentle camera movement, no text, no letters, no words on screen, no speech, only soft natural sound effects.

words.scene: An ancient Chinese emperor in silk robes slumps on his throne, eyelids drooping, yawning slowly and barely able to lift his arm, completely drained of energy.
A pale, weak ancient Chinese king lies in bed under thick blankets, coughing softly, while a kind royal doctor checks his forehead with concern.
An ancient Chinese man walking past a bubbling pot over a fire turns his head for a quick, curious glance at it, then keeps walking.
A cartoon child takes a sip of dark bitter medicine from a cup and scrunches up the whole face in disgust, sticking out the tongue.
A firm but kind royal doctor holds out a cup of herbal medicine and shakes his head as the emperor refuses, then pushes the cup forward again, not taking no for an answer.
A cartoon gardener with big garden shears snips the heads off a row of tall yellow dandelions one after another, the flower heads popping off and tumbling to the grass.
Fragrant golden steam curls up from a cup of fresh tea; a smiling ancient Chinese man closes his eyes and breathes in the lovely smell with delight.
An ancient Chinese emperor takes a sip of golden tea, his eyes light up with sparkles, and he throws his arms up in amazement at how wonderful it tastes.
A cartoon boy suddenly bursts with energy and joy, leaping high into the air with arms wide open in a sunny meadow, laughing with excitement.
A table full of colourful drinks: tea in a teapot, a glass of orange juice, lemonade and hot cocoa; a hand picks one up and pours it into a cup.
A big round stone drops into a calm pond and makes a huge splash, with ripples spreading out wider and wider across the whole water.
An old ancient Chinese healer drinks a softly glowing green herbal drink; his tired face brightens and he stands up straight, feeling strong and healthy.
A tiny camel caravan carrying sacks of tea crosses golden sand dunes far away on the distant horizon, as the camera slowly pulls back to show how far it is.
Two cartoon friends who were arguing sit down, share cups of warm tea, smile, and shake hands in peace and harmony.
A cartoon girl eats one piece of popcorn from a bowl, then another, then another, unable to stop reaching back for more with a happy grin.
The camera glides over a lush green mountain region with terraced tea fields, misty valleys and little villages, like flying over a living map.
A bustling foreign market with bright unusual fruits, a colourful parrot and patterned silks; a curious traveller looks around with wide eyes at all the strange new things.
Hands pour three different kinds of tea leaves and dried flowers into one glass jar and stir them together into a colourful mix.
An ancient Chinese tea ceremony: a woman in traditional robes slowly pours tea from a delicate porcelain teapot into small cups, following an old custom.
A cozy family of little grey pill bugs live under a damp mossy log, tucked into their tiny home with leaves around them like furniture.
A small cartoon pill bug on a hot cracked rock under a scorching sun starts drying out in danger, then hurries into the cool shade just in time.
A team of cartoon ants builds a tall tower of twigs; it wobbles, and one ant slides in the last important piece that keeps the whole tower standing.
A little grey pill bug curls up into a tight ball, and next to it a cartoon armadillo curls into a ball the same way; the two roll side by side like twins.
Close-up of soft dark damp soil and wet moss with glistening water droplets, where little pill bugs crawl happily in the dampness.
A row of many different cartoon crabs, shrimps and pill bugs of different shapes, colours and sizes line up side by side as the camera slides past them.
A little grey pill bug looks at its reflection in a shiny water drop, turning left and right to see how it looks on the outside.
A cartoon girl walks past a bunch of flowers, her nose twitches and her eyes water, and she lets out a big sneeze.
Looking through a microscope: a drop of pond water full of tiny wiggling living creatures, little round cells and swimming specks of life.
Time-lapse on a forest floor: fallen leaves break down as worms and pill bugs munch them, turning into rich soil from which a new green sprout grows.
A cartoon crab slowly wriggles out of its old hard shell, leaving the empty shell behind, and stretches in its new bigger soft shell.
A friendly scientist in a sun hat kneels in a garden with a magnifying glass, carefully studying a honeybee on a flower and smiling with interest.
A cartoon red crab with a hard shell scuttles sideways across a sandy beach, snapping its claws, next to a little shrimp in a rock pool.
Night falls under a big moon; an owl opens its big eyes and wakes up on a branch while little bugs come out to search for food in the dark.
A man in an old-fashioned office sits at a desk with a big ledger book and an abacus, carefully writing rows of small marks and checking his records.
A bored office worker stamps one paper after another in an endless pile, again and again, yawning and slumping as the clock ticks slowly.
An old printing press clanks and rolls, and freshly printed books stack up high; an author holds up the first copy of his book proudly.
An author signs a book, then playfully puts on a fake moustache and glasses disguise and winks, hiding his real identity behind a pen name.
A happy retired grandfather opens a letter at his mailbox, smiles, then relaxes in a garden chair with a cup of tea, enjoying his free time.
A tired man arrives in the green countryside, takes a deep breath of fresh air, stretches, and suddenly skips across the meadow full of youthful energy.
An old cottage window on side hinges swings open like a little door, letting silver moonlight pour into a cozy room.
A cozy farmhouse with a thick golden straw roof glows under the moon, dewdrops sparkling on the straw as the camera moves closer.
A sleepy dog lies curled up comfortably on a soft cushion like a resting log, slowly closing its eyes in peace.
A cute little wooden dog house in a garden at night; a sleepy puppy walks inside, turns around and lies down cozily.
Inside a dim moonlit barn full of dark shadows, a little mouse creeps through the shadowy corners, barely visible.
Under a big bright full moon, farmers gather golden wheat in the autumn fields, tying it into bundles and loading a cart.
A tiny grey mouse scampers quickly across a stone floor with little rapid steps, its tail swishing behind it.
Silver moonlight shimmers on a calm stream, sparkling with a faint gleam of light as the water flows past sleeping trees.
Tall slender green reeds sway gently at the edge of a quiet river at dusk, while a fish swims silently between their stems.
A kind old grandfather sits by the door and pulls on a pair of worn old leather boots, patting them fondly.
A curious cat presses its nose to a window and peers carefully at birds hopping on a branch outside, eyes wide and focused.
White doves fly home at sunset and settle into the little round openings of a wooden dovecote shelter, cooing softly.
A clear blue river flows smoothly and steadily through a green valley, gently carrying a leaf along with the current.
A shy cartoon boy at a busy party slowly steps backwards away from the noisy crowd and settles into a quiet corner by himself.
A little mouse pokes its head out of a tiny hole in the wall, peeps left and right to check for the cat, then pops back in.
A bright silver beam of moonlight shines through a dark room window, making a glowing path of light across the floor.
Underwater view: colourful fish swim slowly beneath the sparkling surface of the water, with sunlight rippling above them.
